statements: Butyrate, sulforaphane, allyl mercaptan, diallyl disulfide, phenethyl isothiocyanate, caffeic acid, and ferulic acid survive only as an unranked historical candidate inventory whose evidence must be evaluated compound by compound.

Selected pharmacological HDAC inhibitors rescued Q141K ABCG2 surface trafficking and substrate-efflux function in Basseville et al. 2012 in vitro; the causal isoform mapping, direct butyrate effect, epithelial exposure, urate flux, and safety remain unestablished.

Xie et al. found that butyrate increased endogenous intestinal BCRP/ABCG2 expression and drug-substrate function in non-Q141K-specific, non-urate rat, primary mouse-enterocyte, and Caco-2 systems; PPAR-gamma antagonism and silencing supported dependence in Caco-2, while the rat PPAR-gamma result was correlational. Combining that induction route with a possible Q141K-trafficking effect is an explicitly untested Research Conjecture owned by wiki/abcg2-modulators.md.
